1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
8:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
9: 
10:   // ----- Game State -----
11:   const ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, w: 40, h: 20, speed: 4, ammo: 10, fuel: 100 };
12:   const bullets = [];
13:   const asteroids = [];
14:   const fuels = [];
15:   let keys = {};
16:   let gameOver = false;
17:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
18:   let lastFuel = 0;
19: 
20:   // ----- Input -----
21:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
22:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
23: 
24:   function spawnAsteroid() {
25:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
26:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (W - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2 });
27:   }
28: 
29:   function spawnFuel() {
30:     const size = 15;
31:     fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * (W - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 1 });
32:   }
33: 
34:   // ----- Game Loop -----
35:   function update(dt) {
36:     if (gameOver) return;
37:     // ship movement
38:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
39:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
40:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.y -= ship.speed;
41:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.y += ship.speed;
42:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
43:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ship.h, ship.y));
44: 
45:     // shooting
46:     if (keys['Space'] && ship.ammo > 0) {
47:       // simple rate limiting: one bullet per 200ms
48:       if (!ship.lastShot || Date.now() - ship.lastShot > 200) {
49:         bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 2, y: ship.y, w: 4, h: 10, speed: 6 });
50:         ship.ammo--;
51:         ship.lastShot = Date.now();
52:       }
53:     }
54: 
55:     // update bullets
56:     bullets.forEach(b => (b.y -= b.speed));
57:     // remove off-screen bullets
58:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (bullets[i].y + bullets[i].h < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
59: 
60:     // spawn asteroids
61:     if (Date.now() - lastAsteroid > 1000) {
62:       spawnAsteroid();
63:       lastAsteroid = Date.now();
64:     }
65:     // spawn fuel pickups
66:     if (Date.now() - lastFuel > 5000) {
67:       spawnFuel();
68:       lastFuel = Date.now();
69:     }
70: 
71:     // update asteroids and check collisions
72:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
73:       const a = asteroids[i];
74:       a.y += a.speed;
75:       // bullet collision
76:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
77:         const b = bullets[j];
78:         if (b.x < a.x + a.w && b.x + b.w > a.x && b.y < a.y + a.h && b.y + b.h > a.y) {
79:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
80:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
81:           break;
82:         }
83:       }
84:       // ship collision
85:       if (!gameOver && ship.x < a.x + a.w && ship.x + ship.w > a.x && ship.y < a.y + a.h && ship.y + ship.h > a.y) {
86:         gameOver = true;
87:       }
88:       // remove off-screen
89:       if (a.y > H) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
90:     }
91: 
92:     // fuel pickups
93:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
94:       const f = fuels[i];
95:       f.y += f.speed;
96:       if (ship.x < f.x + f.w && ship.x + ship.w > f.x && ship.y < f.y + f.h && ship.y + ship.h > f.y) {
97:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
98:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
99:         continue;
100:       }
101:       if (f.y > H) fuels.splice(i, 1);
102:     }
103: 
104:     // fuel consumption
105:     ship.fuel -= dt * 0.02; // drain over time
106:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
107:   }
108: 
109:   function draw() {
110:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
111:     // ship
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
113:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
114:     // bullets
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
116:     bullets.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h));
117:     // asteroids
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
119:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
120:     // fuel pickups
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
122:     fuels.forEach(f => ctx.fillRect(f.x, f.y, f.w, f.h));
123:     // UI
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
125:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
126:     ctx.fillText(`Ammo: ${ship.ammo}`, 10, 20);
127:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.round(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
128:     if (gameOver) {
129:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
130:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
131:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
132:       ctx.font = '36px sans-serif';
133:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
134:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
135:     }
136:   }
137: 
138:   let last = performance.now();
139:   function loop() {
140:     const now = performance.now();
141:     const dt = now - last;
142:     last = now;
143:     update(dt);
144:     draw();
145:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146:     else setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 3000);
147:   }
148:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
149: })();

(End of file - total 149 lines)
</content>
